q: The Riemann mapping theorem states that any simply connected proper open subset U ⊊ ℂ is:
opts: Conformally equivalent to the upper half-plane only
Conformally equivalent to the unit disk 𝔻 (by a biholomorphic map)
exp: Riemann mapping theorem: any simply connected U ⊊ ℂ is biholomorphic to 𝔻. The map is unique up to Möbius transformations of 𝔻. This is a cornerstone of complex analysis and is used in complex dynamics to study basins of attraction.
